literal: every time one loses, will desire, gambling indeed, like, sorrow, every time one suffers, it has desire, life
translation: Just as a gambler desires the game even more every time he loses, the soul clings to life with desire every time it suffers sorrow.
modern: சூதாட்டத்தில் பொருளை இழக்க இழக்க அதன்மேல் ஆசை பெருகுவது போல, துன்பத்தை அனுபவிக்க அனுபவிக்க உயிரானது வாழ்வின் மேல் ஆசை கொள்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet compares the soul's attachment to life with a gambler's addiction to the game. Even when a gambler loses everything, his desire to play only increases. Similarly, even when a person experiences continuous sorrow and suffering, the soul does not want to let go, but clings to life with even greater desire. The rhyming words 'இழத்தொறூஉம்' (every time one loses) and 'உழத்தொறூஉம்' (every time one suffers) beautifully parallel this addictive attachment.
